'''Station 2LC/Blue''' was a [[Bavos-I heavy-duty military space platform|Bavos-I space platform]] that served as a border outpost on the boundary between [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]] and [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]], located near the [[Ringali Nebula/Legends|Ringali Nebula]]. Like [[Station 1B6/Green]], 2LC/Blue was under the command of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial naval]] installations at [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]].

2LC/Blue hosted thirty-six [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] from [[SilverWing Squadron|SilverWing]] and [[GoldWing Squadron|GoldWing]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] and was frequently visited by the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Scourge (Victory I-class)|''Scourge'']].

The station dated back to the time of the [[Esselian Empire]], and originally delineated part of the Esselian border.
